name: FMP API Dark Theme Refresh
description: check this project if it uses FMP API to fetch stock data and generate the latest html also removed unwanted project related info and make it in dark theme.

goal.answer: Verify FMP API usage, remove unwanted content, implement dark theme with toggle, refresh stock data with top 100 stocks per category, and add FMP attribution

criteria.answer:
FMP API usage confirmed in fetch_yahoo_data.py
Yahoo Finance references removed from index.html info panel
Hero card 'What this site offers' section removed from index.html
Dark theme implemented with light/dark toggle in header
Theme preference persisted in localStorage, respects system preference
All CSS variables updated for dark mode
Script updated to fetch top 100 stocks per category (large/mid/small cap) via FMP stock screener
Stock data refreshed: fetch_yahoo_data.py re-run to regenerate data/stocks.json
All 4 HTML pages render correctly in both themes
No console errors, modal functionality works in both themes
FMP attribution/credits added in footer or info panel
GitHub Actions refresh-stocks.yml verified to use FMP_API_KEY and updated script

constraints.answer: Static GitHub Pages site - no backend changes, Must use existing FMP_API_KEY from GitHub secrets, Bilingual support (Tamil/English) must be preserved, Existing stock card/modal UI patterns must be maintained, GitHub Actions workflow must continue to run on schedule

phases.answer: Update fetch script & refresh data, Implement dark theme & UI changes, Verify GitHub Actions & test

assumptions.answer: FMP stock screener endpoint (stable/company-screener or v3/stock-screener) supports exchange=NSE and marketCap filters for Indian stocks. Market cap thresholds: Large cap > $2.4B, Mid cap $600M-$2.4B, Small cap < $600M (USD). The profile endpoint continues to work with .NS symbols. GitHub Actions has FMP_API_KEY secret configured. User has FMP_API_KEY locally to test script changes.

phases.name: Update fetch script & refresh data
phases.goal: Modify fetch_yahoo_data.py to use FMP stock screener for top 100 stocks per category, then regenerate stocks.json
phases.description: Replace hardcoded CATEGORIES with dynamic screener calls for NSE exchange with market cap ranges. Fetch profiles for returned symbols. Run script locally to generate fresh data/stocks.json.

steps.description: Update fetch_yahoo_data.py: add stock screener calls for large/mid/small cap with appropriate marketCapMoreThan/LowerThan and exchange=NSE, limit=100

verification.command: python scripts/fetch_yahoo_data.py && test -f data/stocks.json && python -c "import json; d=json.load(open('data/stocks.json')); print({k: len(v) for k,v in d.items()})"

steps.description: Run updated script with FMP_API_KEY to generate fresh stocks.json with ~100 stocks per category

verification.command: test -f data/stocks.json && python -c "import json; d=json.load(open('data/stocks.json')); print('largecap:', len(d.get('largecap', []))); print('midcap:', len(d.get('midcap', []))); print('smallcap:', len(d.get('smallcap', [])))"

phases.summary: Phase 1 complete: Updated fetch_yahoo_data.py with expanded symbol lists (~100 per category) and concurrent fetching. Generated fresh data/stocks.json with 115 largecap, 115 midcap, 87 smallcap stocks. FMP API usage confirmed via stable/profile endpoint. Note: FMP stock screener requires paid tier (402 error), so used expanded hardcoded lists instead.

phases.name: Implement dark theme & UI changes
phases.goal: Add dark theme with toggle, remove unwanted content, add FMP attribution
phases.description: Update CSS variables for dark mode, add theme toggle button in header, update index.html to remove hero card and fix Yahoo reference, add FMP credits in footer

steps.description: Update assets/styles.css: add dark mode CSS variables and [data-theme=dark] overrides for all color variables
Update assets/app.js: add theme toggle logic (localStorage, system preference, toggle button handler)
Update all 4 HTML files: add theme toggle button in header next to language switcher, add data-theme attribute to html/body
Update index.html: remove hero card section, update info panel text from Yahoo Finance to FMP

verification.command: ! grep -q 'What this site offers' index.html && grep -q 'FMP' index.html

steps.description: Add FMP attribution/credits in footer across all pages

verification.command: grep -q 'Financial Modeling Prep' index.html largecap.html midcap.html smallcap.html

phases.name: Verify GitHub Actions & test
phases.goal: Confirm workflow uses updated script and test full site in both themes
phases.description: Verify refresh-stocks.yml will work with updated script, test all pages locally

steps.description: Verify .github/workflows/refresh-stocks.yml uses FMP_API_KEY and runs updated fetch_yahoo_data.py
Test all 4 pages in browser (or headless) for both light/dark themes - no console errors, modal works

verification.command: echo 'Manual verification: open index.html, largecap.html, midcap.html, smallcap.html in browser; toggle theme; verify no console errors; test modal; verify search/sort'
